name: Ops Landing
summary: A complete marketing page for an operations assistant: scroll-pill header, phone scroll hero, inline-image headline, phone feature tabs, integration grid, two phone split sections, chat testimonials, setup steps, FAQ and a night CTA footer, each overridable by props.
useWhen: A full product landing page is needed in one import, with sections in a proven order
Starting point for a page where each section's copy is swapped through props
avoidWhen: Only one or two sections are needed; use the section components directly
A different section order or a non-phone product story is required
